preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string a for each test case must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in a)
preconditions.description: The string a must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output string b must have the same length as the input string a.
The output string b must be a permutation of the input string a.

postconditions.expression: not any(c in b for c in 'trygub')
postconditions.description: The output string b must not contain 'trygub' as a subsequence.
